reason: A web GUI interface enhancement that adds an interactive animated desktop-pet overlay synchronized with agent session states and configurable through local UI controls.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 添加可拖拽、可缩放并能随智能体状态变化显示动画和气泡的像素风桌宠。
summaries.en: Adds an interactive pixel-art pet to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with state-aware animations, speech bubbles, dragging, resizing, and display preferences.

capabilities: renders an animated pixel-art pet in the web interface
reflects agent session states through animations and localized text
supports dragging, positioning, resizing, hiding, and context-menu controls
persists display preferences in browser localStorage
serves sprite assets through a host web-server route
